title: Open Trestle spending limit v1
description: One API key's local spending limit, stored as a protected 0600 file in the private usage folder. It is keyed by the provider ID and the credential reference identity of the key variable, the identity every setup records for that variable name, so every setup that names the variable shares the limit. The limit is best effort: Open Trestle compares it with its own upper-bound estimate of review spend, not a provider bill, and the provider's own limit is the guarantee. The record holds the variable name, never the key. The native parser additionally requires the canonical encoding, the credential reference identity derived from the name, and alert percentages in strictly ascending order.

credential_environment.description: The name of the environment variable that holds the key. The key itself is never stored.

credential_reference_identity.description: SHA-256 of open-trestle/provider-credential-environment/ followed by the variable name.

period.description: A calendar period in UTC: a week from Monday 00:00, a month from its first day, a year from 1 January.

limit_micro_usd.description: The limit in micro-US-dollars (1 USD = 1000000), whole cents.
